name: Нож Гвоздя
notes: One of Гвоздь's knives, a generic type fought in fours: a quick clanless dwarf with a belt of daggers who works the edges of a fight. Knives never fight alone; they close in two at a time, feint, step, and cut, and they throw a dagger at anyone who keeps away. One of the four at the port warehouse was sent to check the ropes on Мирайя when the fight broke out. He counts as one of Гвоздь's bought men for Bought Men.

standardItems.text:
Trigger The knife is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker he can see.

Effect The knife gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
The knife deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] creatures.

actions.name: Gang Up
actions.text: Any enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] against the knife's melee attacks due to flanking as long as the enemy is within melee reach of both the knife and one of the knife's allies.
